description.text: The major closely follows the development trends of the discipline, taking information technology as a support. It is featured with electricity network control for the carrier and network control. It is designed to train professionals capable of engineering design, system analysis, system operation, management and decision-making work or various Electric (electrical) the research and development of automation equipment in the field of electrical engineering, power electronics technology, power detection and automated instrumentation, motion control, industrial process control, electronics and computer technology. The main features of the major lies in that it combines electrical engineering with automation, strong electricity with weak electricity, electrical technology with electronic technology, and software with hardware. It focuses its training on electrical engineering, power electronics, power line carrier and automation. Targeted to the power industry and its relevant industries, it has great market demand for talents in all sectors of the national economy.

duration.text: The Electric Engineering and Automation at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
